summary: Verified all weekly candidates with source checks. Approved four completed European consumer/luxury brand ownership changes: Baume & Mercier to Damiani Group, Creed/Kering Beauté to L'Oréal, Versace to Prada Group, and Charvet to Chanel. Rejected Hugo Boss, Rail Europe, and Skroutz because the evidence still shows announced/pending processes rather than a completed transfer of control as of 2026-08-02.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Italian jewellery group Damiani completed its acquisition of 100% of Swiss watchmaker Baume & Mercier from Richemont on 2026-07-01.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Richemont and Damiani stated that the previously announced private transaction for Damiani Group to acquire 100% of Baume & Mercier had been completed after fulfilment of conditions precedent. Richemont said Baume & Mercier joins Damiani Group's portfolio; Richemont will provide interim operational services during integration.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completed 100% acquisition is directly confirmed by an official Richemont press release dated 2026-07-01, and no duplicate existing ownership row was present.

sources.title: Richemont and the Damiani Group announce the completion of the acquisition of Baume & Mercier by the Damiani Group
sources.summary: Official release says Richemont and Damiani Group completed Damiani Group's acquisition of 100% of specialist watchmaker Baume & Mercier on 2026-07-01 after conditions precedent were fulfilled.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: L'Oréal completed its acquisition of Kering Beauté, including luxury fragrance house Creed, on 2026-03-31.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: The transaction is best normalized as Creed/Kering Beauté rather than the Kering fashion houses: L'Oréal acquired Kering Beauté including the House of Creed and signed long-term beauty licences for selected Kering brands. Kering itself remains independent and the fashion houses were not acquired.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official L'Oréal/L'Oréal Finance release directly confirms completion of L'Oréal's acquisition of Kering Beauté, including Creed, on 2026-03-31. The record is normalized to the consumer-facing Creed brand and does not duplicate an existing row.

sources.title: L’Oréal completes the acquisition of Kering Beauté within the framework of its strategic alliance with Kering
sources.summary: Official news release states that L'Oréal and Kering announced completion of L'Oréal's acquisition of Kering Beauté, including the House of Creed, on 2026-03-31.

sources.title: First quarter 2026 sales
sources.summary: L'Oréal's Q1 2026 sales communication states that L'Oréal completed the landmark acquisition of Kering Beauté on 2026-03-31, reinforcing current ownership within L'Oréal.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Prada Group completed its acquisition of Versace from Capri Holdings on 2025-12-02 after receiving required regulatory clearances.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Prada's completion announcement says Prada S.p.A. completed the acquisition of Versace from Capri Holdings. Prada's 2025 annual reporting further identifies the acquired business as 100% of Givi Holding S.r.l. (Versace Group).
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completion is confirmed by both buyer and seller-side official sources, plus Capri's SEC filing. No existing current-owner row for Versace was present, so no supersession is needed.

sources.title: Prada Group completes the acquisition of Versace
sources.summary: Prada Group announced successful completion of the acquisition of Versace from Capri Holdings on 2025-12-02 after receiving all required regulatory clearances.

sources.title: Capri Holdings Completes Sale of Versace
sources.summary: Seller-side release states Capri Holdings completed the previously announced sale of Versace to Prada S.p.A. on 2025-12-02.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Capri Holdings
sources.title: Capri Holdings Form 8-K, 2025-12-02
sources.summary: Capri's Form 8-K states it completed the sale of subsidiaries operating the Versace business to Prada S.p.A. on 2025-12-02 for cash consideration subject to adjustments.

sources.title: Annual Report 2025
sources.summary: Prada's 2025 annual report states that on 2025-12-02 Prada completed the acquisition of 100% share capital of Givi Holding S.r.l. (Versace Group).

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Chanel acquired historic Paris shirtmaker Charvet in July 2026, ending the brand's long independent ownership.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: No primary Chanel transaction release was found, but multiple reputable media reports cite Chanel/Charvet statements and treat the acquisition as completed. Chanel's own legal and governance materials identify Chanel Limited as a private UK-headquartered company operating the CHANEL brand; widely reported ultimate control remains with the Wertheimer family, so ultimate ownership is noted with moderate complexity.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Approved despite absence of a primary transaction page because reputable fashion/business media directly state Chanel has acquired Charvet and quote both Chanel and Charvet management statements. The transaction is completed rather than pending and no duplicate existing row exists.

sources.title: Chanel Acquires Charvet
sources.summary: Article states Chanel has acquired Charvet and says the house announced the acquisition on 2026-07-02, with statements from Chanel fashion president Bruno Pavlovsky and Charvet managing director Jean-Claude Colban.

sources.title: Chanel acquires Charles Haughey’s shirtmaker Charvet
sources.summary: Financial Times article republished by The Irish Times states Chanel acquired Charvet, including the Paris Place Vendôme headquarters and store, and that Charvet will operate as an independent business under Chanel ownership.

sources.title: Chanel ha acquisito la storica camiceria Charvet
sources.summary: Italian news agency report states Chanel acquired the historic shirtmaker Charvet and includes statements describing the combination of two historic Parisian companies.

sources.title: Legal Statement / Modern Slavery Statement 2025
sources.summary: Chanel's own legal and modern slavery materials state Chanel Limited is a private company headquartered in the United Kingdom and operates subsidiaries under the CHANEL brand.

sources.title: Chanel Limited Financial Results for the Year Ended 31 December 2025
sources.summary: Chanel's 2025 financial results identify Chanel Limited and confirm the group's private luxury activities, global CEO/CFO, and ongoing investments in brand activities and suppliers.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected as not completed by the 2026-08-02 review date. HUGO BOSS confirmed an unsolicited voluntary takeover offer on 2026-06-10 and recommended shareholders not accept on 2026-07-09. Frasers' 2026-07-28 RNS says the EU merger-control condition was satisfied and the offer became unconditional, but it also states the additional acceptance period remains open until 2026-08-13; no final tender/settlement result or transfer of control was found.

Rejected as announced/pending only. Omio's 2026-07-16 official release says Omio Group entered into an agreement to acquire Rail Europe and describes what would happen upon completion; it does not confirm closing or current ownership transfer.

Rejected as an update to keep pending rather than approve. Blackstone's 2026-05-11 release says funds managed by Blackstone entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake and that the transaction is expected to close in H2 2026 subject to regulatory approvals. Existing row skroutz_2026 should remain pending unless a later completion source is found.
